timeline.author: jimczi

timeline.body:
The random tests in `CompositeAggregatorTests` create lots of segments since #78313. That can lead to out of memory in tests.
The additional commits were added to simulate the multi-segments case but the random index writer should already perform some random overcommits.

Closes #78919

Do you think it'd still be nice to commit sometimes to force a few segments? It looks like `frequently` is about 99% of the time. Maybe we want to commit every 10th document or something?

Also, wow. I hadn't realized that committing every document without merges was going to be that expensive. I guess it makes sense, but that's only a couple hundred segments. We run the tests with 512mb of ram I think. So we're at like 1mb a segment?

reply.body:
The test uses a random directory so it sometimes uses the ByteBuffersDirectory which is entirely on heap.

>  It looks like frequently is about 99% of the time. Maybe we want to commit every 10th document or something?

The `RandomIndexWriter` does that already which is why I removed these additional commits.

timeline.body:
Fair enough. The random writer will make many segments quite most of the
time anyway.

Lgtm
